name: Headscale
summary: HTTP 8080 checked with /health, with the control connection kept open.
notes: Every Tailscale client holds one connection open to the control server, started as an HTTP upgrade, so the timeout is long. Headscale has to be told its public address (server_url, with https://) and to trust this node (trusted_proxies), and it listens on 127.0.0.1 until listen_addr says otherwise. With the embedded relay in use, its STUN on UDP 3478 cannot pass through here and has to be reachable directly.
